description:
Greetings!



Are you familiar with an animator called Gakilsam? This set was inspired by their works. Depicting a group of modern day people who unapologetically put nightmares, horror monsters and other creeps into the ground. These people make ghosts shiver. Fits a rather dark, industrial vibe. And gives me the opportunity to use a weapon that has been barely used in the entire Eorzea Collection! Don't mind if I do!



Hope you like it!



Have Fun!
title: Nightmare Hunter (Dark Knight)

Not many notes on this one, the gear is all very easily accessible and aside from the boots it's all dyeable from the get go, but I didn't due them anyway. All the pieces bar the boots are cheap on the mb or easy to craft with older mats. Visor is off for the cap to use the headwear glasses.

For this glam, I took a lot of inspiration from areas like Shaaloani. For some reason, the desert atmosphere immediately made me think about adding goggles, because of the sandstorms and that kind of explorer vibe.

The overall earthy color palette also gave me the right feeling for this Viper. Also, aren’t snakes usually associated with desert environments? I'm not entirely sure, but it felt like it matched the theme really well.
title: Shaaloani Viper

description:
Wanted something a little fancy looking but also like he could go travelling in it. 



I love having little pops of colour here and there to tie things together so these pants were perfect; I love the straps and that the second dye channel is for the pockets.



Also wanted to lean a little bit into the battlefield medic thing so I chose a jacket that has a couple of little armour details.
